nifte.config.title: Nifte Settings
nifte.config.hide_dead_mobs.tooltip: Make mobs disappear immediately when they die instead of playing the death animation.
nifte.config.highlight_hostile_mobs.tool: Draw an outline around hostile mobs.
nifte.config.highlight_other_players.too: Draw an outline around other players.
nifte.config.player_tracers.tooltip: Draw lines from your cursor to nearby players.
nifte.config.player_tracers.range.toolti: How far away tracers should track other players.
nifte.config.ignore_grass.tooltip: Attack mobs through tall grass and similar plants without breaking them.
nifte.config.keep_sprint.tooltip: Keep sprinting after you run into a wall instead of slowing down.
nifte.config.quick_eat.tooltip: Hold the bound key to swap to food, eat, then swap back when you release.
nifte.config.quick_use.tooltip: Use items from specific hotbar slots with their own key binds.
nifte.config.quick_use.slot.tooltip: Use the item in this hotbar slot when the key is pressed.
nifte.config.fps.tooltip: Show your current frames per second on the HUD.
nifte.config.fps.anchor.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the FPS indicator is placed in.
nifte.config.fps.x.tooltip: How far to move the FPS indicator horizontally from its position.
nifte.config.fps.y.tooltip: How far to move the FPS indicator vertically from its position.
nifte.config.fps.scale.tooltip: How large the FPS indicator is.
nifte.config.fps.color.tooltip: Text color of the FPS indicator.
nifte.config.fps.hide_debug.tooltip: Hide the FPS indicator while the F3 debug overlay is open.
nifte.config.armor.tooltip: Show remaining durability for your armor on the HUD.
nifte.config.armor.anchor.tooltip: Where the armor HUD is placed on the screen.
nifte.config.armor.x.tooltip: How far to move the armor HUD horizontally from its position.
nifte.config.armor.y.tooltip: How far to move the armor HUD vertically from its position.
nifte.config.armor.scale.tooltip: How large the armor HUD is.
nifte.config.armor.held.tooltip: Also show durability for the items in your hands.
nifte.config.potion.tooltip: Show remaining time on your potion effect icons.
nifte.config.mob_health.tooltip: Show the hp/armor of the mob or player you are looking at.
nifte.config.mob_health.anchor.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the overlay is placed in.
nifte.config.mob_health.x.tooltip: How far to move the overlay horizontally from its position.
nifte.config.mob_health.y.tooltip: How far to move the overlay vertically from its position.
nifte.config.mob_health.fade.tooltip: How long the overlay stays after you look away.
nifte.config.mob_health.reach.tooltip: How far away you can look at a mob or player to show their health.
nifte.config.compass.tooltip: Show a heading compass at the top of the screen.
nifte.config.trajectory.tooltip: Draw a line showing where bows, pearls, and other projectiles will land.
nifte.config.chat_avatars.tooltip: Show player heads next to their chat messages.
nifte.config.ping.tooltip: Show ping as a number instead of bars in the player list.
nifte.config.food_hunger.tooltip: Show how much hunger a food item restores next to its name.
nifte.config.shulker_tooltip.tooltip: Preview a shulker box's contents when you hover over it.
nifte.config.front_third_person.tooltip: Skip the front-facing camera when cycling perspectives.
nifte.config.auto_third_person.tooltip: Switch to third person while flying with an elytra or riding a mount, then back to first person when you land or dismount.
nifte.config.dynamic_third_person.toolti: In third person, the mouse moves the camera and movement keys aim the player.
nifte.config.zoom.tooltip: Hold the bound key to zoom the camera. Scroll while zoomed to adjust FOV.
nifte.config.zoom.fov.tooltip: How far the camera zooms in. Scroll while zoomed to change this temporarily.
nifte.config.zoom.transition.tooltip: Smooth eases the camera in and out. Instant snaps to the zoom FOV immediately.
nifte.config.disable_fog.tooltip: Remove distance, water, lava, and status-effect fog.
nifte.config.lower_fire.tooltip: Move the first-person fire overlay farther down your screen.
nifte.config.lower_fire.offset.tooltip: How far down to move the fire overlay.
nifte.config.lower_shield.tooltip: Move first-person shields farther down your screen.
nifte.config.lower_shield.offset.tooltip: How far down to move shields.
nifte.config.hide_held_totem.tooltip: Hide the Totem of Undying in first person.
nifte.config.fullbright.tooltip: Light the world as if it were fully bright, including caves and night.
nifte.config.item_scroll.tooltip: Scroll over a slot to move items one at a time between your inventory and the container.
nifte.config.sort.tooltip: Press the bound key while hovering a container to sort its items.
nifte.config.container_drag.tooltip: Drag items more smoothly, including depositing stacks while dragging.
nifte.config.drop_confirm.tooltip: Require pressing drop a second time before items are thrown.
nifte.config.drop_confirm.seconds.toolti: How long you have to press drop again to confirm.
nifte.config.gui_move.tooltip: Use movement keys while a container or inventory is open.
nifte.config.bedrock_bridging.tooltip: Place blocks against air at edges, like bridging in Bedrock Edition.
nifte.config.fast_block_placement.toolti: Remove the delay between placements. While holding right-click, only continues placing against the same block face as your first click.
nifte.config.block_restock.tooltip: When the block in your hand runs out, swap in a matching stack from your inventory.
nifte.config.bucket_restock.tooltip: When a liquid bucket  in your hand is used up, swap in a matching bucket from your inventory.
nifte.config.consumable_restock.tooltip: When a potion or stew in your hand is used up, swap in a matching one from your inventory.
nifte.config.auto_totem.tooltip: Move another Totem of Undying into your offhand after one is used.
nifte.config.auto_elytra.tooltip: Swap to an elytra when you jump in the air, then restore your chestplate when you land.
nifte.config.auto_tool.tooltip: Swap to the best tool for the block you're mining.
nifte.config.auto_tool.inventory.tooltip: Search your inventory for a better tool, not just the hotbar.
nifte.config.auto_weapon.tooltip: Swap to the best weapon for the mob you're attacking.
nifte.config.auto_weapon.inventory.toolt: Search your inventory for a better weapon, not just the hotbar.
nifte.config.tool_protect.tooltip: Stop using a tool when it is about to break.
nifte.config.no_break_delay.tooltip: Start mining the next block immediately after one breaks.
nifte.config.unlock_recipes.tooltip: Show every recipe in the recipe book, including ones you have not unlocked.
nifte.config.recipe_scroll.tooltip: Mouse wheel cycles pages in the recipe book.
nifte.config.recipe_centered.tooltip: Don't shift the inventory to the side when the recipe book is open.
nifte.config.instant_craft.tooltip: Craft items immediately when you click them in the recipe book.
nifte.config.toasts.advancement.tooltip: Hide the popup that appears when you earn an advancement.
nifte.config.toasts.recipe.tooltip: Hide the popup that appears when you unlock a recipe.
